shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pair: Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.fullbody: The whole person is visible from head to shoes, standing, with a little space above the head and below the shoes.

assets.item: Why is Sofia thirsty? Because she is running.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Sofia. Keep her face, long curly dark hair, warm brown skin and build exactly. Her hair is tied back. She wears a bright pink running top, black running leggings and running shoes. Create a new photograph: in a green park on a hot sunny morning, Sofia has just stopped running on the path; she is out of breath, a little sweaty, and drinks thirstily from a clear plastic bottle of water held up to her mouth. Her running clothes and the park path make it obvious she is running.

reference_file.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair, warm brown skin, white blouse under a bright blue blazer) writes in a large notebook at a wooden desk by a bright window in her home study (A1+ 1.2).

assets.item: Why is Diego sad? Because his dog is sick.
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Diego. Keep his face, dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard and build exactly. He wears his burgundy button shirt. Create a new photograph: in his bright living room, Diego kneels on the rug beside his medium-sized brown dog, which lies flat on a blue blanket with its eyes half closed, clearly unwell and weak; a small bowl of food beside it is untouched. Diego strokes the dog's head gently and looks very sad. The only person is Diego; the dog is clearly his.
